title: NSF pilots 4-year PhDs with industry research placements
ai_summary:

• Placements will foster collaborative research and real-world skill development for students.
• Participating industries to provide financial support, internships, and full-time job offers.
student_angle: This opportunity can provide valuable industry experience and networking for PhD students.

title: AI's top startups are barely publishing their research
ai_summary:
• AI startups like Tesla, Google Brain, and DeepMind lack transparency in published research.
• They share limited knowledge on AI models and techniques, hindering industry progress.
• Exclusive focus on commercial success may sacrifice scientific contributions to AI research.

ai_summary:

student_angle: Consider learning to develop for AR/VR as it's a rapidly growing field in tech.

title: Show HN: Open-source engine running Gemma 4 26B in 2 GB RAM on any M-series Mac
ai_summary:

title: LLM Honeypot
ai_summary:
• Large Language Model (LLM) "honeypots" exposed, compromising sensitive data and model integrity.
• Researchers discovered these honeypots in major LLM databases, compromising user trust and security.
• Vendors and institutions face growing pressure to secure and audit their AI and ML models.
student_angle: Learning LLMs is valuable, but prioritizing security and risk mitigation is crucial, especially for interns working with sensitive data.

title: The Productivity Mirage
ai_summary:
• Productivity tools often create more work than they save, leading to a decrease in overall efficiency.
• Multitasking and switching between tasks can reduce productivity by up to 40%.
• Constant notifications from tools and apps can lead to distraction and reduced focus.

student_angle: This move shows Keychron's emphasis on innovation and community engagement, increasing internship opportunities in product management and software engineering.

title: Kuna: Decompiler Development in the Age of Coding Agents
ai_summary:

title: The Cold Email
ai_summary:
• A cold email is an unsolicited, direct email to job seekers, usually addressed to hiring managers.
• Its purpose is to get an interview or meeting to discuss potential job openings.
• Crafting a perfect cold email requires proper research, writing, and etiquette.
student_angle: Worth learning how to craft effective cold emails to expand job search networks.

title: The Hugging Face AI break-in, as told through an increasingly committed bear metaphor
ai_summary:

• Campsite owner rushes to secure property, echoing the swift response by Hugging Face in addressing the security breach.
• A bruised but wiser bear, representing the importance of robust access controls and continuous security monitoring in AI systems.
student_angle: Don't dismiss learning about Hugging Face or its AI models, as this breach highlights the ongoing threat to AI security.
